subject.title: fix #95351: [Feature]: Generic JSONL line-parsing hook for CliBackendPlugin (native tool-card support beyond claude-stream-json)

question: Should OpenClaw publish and support `CliBackendPlugin.parseJsonlEvent` plus its normalized display-event union as a stable public plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The patch is intentionally additive and opt-in, but it establishes a new long-lived extension API whose supported semantics, evolution, and ownership cannot be inferred safely from parser tests alone.

options.title: Sponsor the SDK hook
options.body: Accept the backend-owned normalized JSONL parser as the supported plugin extension seam, subject to a refreshed merge review and real external-CLI proof.

options.title: Request a narrower contract
options.body: Ask for a reduced or differently shaped API before merge if the normalized tool, thinking, result, or session event union is broader than the desired stable surface.

options.title: Keep this capability external for now
options.body: Decline the new core SDK surface and direct the integration toward currently supported plugin behavior until a broader API design is accepted.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the SDK hook
recommendation.body: Accept the backend-owned normalized JSONL parser as the supported plugin extension seam, subject to a refreshed merge review and real external-CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked feature request defines the product need and proposed boundary; a verified current-main SDK owner should be added after history inspection is available.
